spec.title: Call-count range for graph statistics
spec.summary: Add call_count_range(frequencies: list[FunctionCallFrequency]) -> int to the existing orchestrator.pkg.stats module. Return the maximum call_count minus the minimum, or zero for empty input. Do not mutate or reorder the input.
spec.technical_notes: Modify src/orchestrator/pkg/stats.py, reuse its FunctionCallFrequency dataclass, and add focused tests. Counts are nonnegative integers. Use full type annotations and follow repository conventions.
acceptance_criteria: Empty and singleton inputs return zero
Input objects and ordering are unchanged
The helper is in the existing stats module

spec.title: Histogram of graph function call counts
spec.summary: Create a module in orchestrator.pkg with call_count_histogram(frequencies: list[FunctionCallFrequency]) -> dict[int, int]. Map each observed call_count to the number of input records with that count. Return an empty dictionary for empty input and preserve all input objects and their order.
spec.technical_notes: Reuse the real FunctionCallFrequency from orchestrator.pkg.stats. The counts are nonnegative integers. Choose a suitable new module; do not change existing source modules. Add focused tests and full type annotations.
acceptance_criteria: Empty input returns an empty dictionary
Repeated call_count values are counted, including zero
Input records are not modified or reordered
Implementation is a new module within orchestrator.pkg using the existing dataclass
